note: Screenshots of OpenScript running in the /trading page of OpenAlgo, on Indian market instruments. Files live in public/script/screens/. Reference one in a page with {{screen: id}}.

trading-workspace.alt: The /trading page with a HalfTrend study written in OpenScript on a BHEL 15 minute NSE chart and its source open in the Scripts panel
trading-workspace.caption: A HalfTrend study written in OpenScript on a BHEL 15 minute NSE chart, with its source open in the Scripts panel.

scripts-panel.alt: The Scripts panel listing saved OpenScript files
scripts-panel.caption: The Scripts panel: your saved studies and strategies, with a new script one click away.

editor.alt: The OpenScript editor in the Scripts panel showing the HalfTrend study with syntax colouring and a numbered gutter
editor.caption: The Scripts panel editor: the language's own highlighting, a numbered gutter and save on Ctrl+S.

editor-diagnostics.alt: The Scripts panel console listing a compile error with its line, code and fix
editor-diagnostics.caption: Every save compiles. The console under the editor names the line, the error code and the fix.

study-overlay.alt: An EMA cross study on a daily SBIN chart with a green and red trend band and labelled golden and death crosses
study-overlay.caption: An overlay study on a daily NSE chart: two EMAs, the band between them shaded by trend, and each crossover labelled.

study-pane.alt: An oscillator study drawn in its own pane below the price chart
study-pane.caption: A study with overlay = false gets its own pane below the price.

supertrend.alt: Supertrend study on a BHEL 15 minute NSE chart: a lime band under price in uptrends, a red band above it in downtrends, the protected side shaded and BUY and SELL labels at each flip
supertrend.caption: Supertrend on a BHEL 15 minute chart: the band trails price, the side it protects is shaded, and every flip is labelled.

indicator-picker.alt: The indicators dialog listing OpenScript studies
indicator-picker.caption: Saved scripts appear in the indicators dialog beside the built-in studies.

study-settings.alt: The settings dialog of a study showing its inputs
study-settings.caption: Every input() becomes a field in the study's settings dialog.

table-dashboard.alt: A table dashboard fixed to a corner of the chart
table-dashboard.caption: A table fixed to a corner of the chart, updated on every bar.

zones-boxes.alt: Supply and demand zones drawn as boxes on the chart
zones-boxes.caption: Drawing objects: zones drawn with draw.box.

higher-timeframe.alt: A daily bias read onto an intraday chart
higher-timeframe.caption: A higher timeframe value read with req.timeframe on an intraday chart.

backtest-panel.alt: The Backtest panel with strategy, date range, inputs and the settings the strategy declares
backtest-panel.caption: The Backtest panel: pick a strategy and a range, adjust its inputs, and run it in the browser.

backtest-report.alt: Backtest report figures: net profit, return, trades, win rate, profit factor, expectancy, drawdown and run-up
backtest-report.caption: The report: net profit, return, win rate, profit factor, expectancy, drawdown and run-up, from one run.

backtest-trades.alt: The trade list of a backtest with side, entry, exit and net result
backtest-trades.caption: Every trade the run made, with its entry, exit and net result.

strategy-on-chart.alt: Backtest entries and exits marked on an NSE chart
strategy-on-chart.caption: Each fill of the run is marked on the bar it happened on: entries, exits and their size.

strategies-panel.alt: The Strategies panel with a deployed OpenScript strategy
strategies-panel.caption: The Strategies panel: deploy a strategy to sandbox trading first, then live.

alerts-panel.alt: The Alerts panel with Alerts and Log tabs, a search box, a status filter and one active alert
alerts-panel.caption: The Alerts panel: every alert with its instrument, interval and status, and a Log of every trigger.

alert-create.alt: The Create alert dialog set to watch a plot of an OpenScript study
alert-create.caption: Create alert: watch a price, a study plot, a drawing level or a candle condition, and choose how it fires.

alert-on-chart.alt: A price alert drawn as a labelled line on an NSE chart beside the Alerts panel
alert-on-chart.caption: An alert is drawn on the chart it watches, and listed in the Alerts panel with its status.

alert-toast.alt: A notification raised by a study's alert on the chart
alert-toast.caption: An alert raised by a running study appears as a notification on the chart.

interval-menu.alt: The chart interval menu with minute, hour and day intervals
interval-menu.caption: The chart interval decides the bars a script runs over.

objects-panel.alt: The Objects panel listing the chart's source and studies with Hide, Settings and Remove
objects-panel.caption: The Objects panel lists every study on the chart, with Hide, Settings and Remove.

new-script.alt: The new script form with a name and a Study or Strategy kind
new-script.caption: New script: give it a name and choose Study or Strategy.

study-style.alt: The Style tab of a study's settings dialog with a colour per plot
study-style.caption: The Style tab: every plot can be switched off or recoloured without touching the code.

symbol-search.alt: Symbol search listing NSE and BSE equities and NFO futures and options
symbol-search.caption: Symbol search: cash, futures and options on Indian exchanges, in OpenAlgo's common symbol format.

deploy-form.alt: The form for deploying a strategy with instrument, exchange, interval, product and inputs
deploy-form.caption: Deploying a strategy: the script, the instrument, the interval, the product and its inputs.

halftrend.alt: HalfTrend study on a BHEL 15 minute chart: a blue up level and a red down level with shaded channels and Buy and Sell labels
halftrend.caption: HalfTrend, written in OpenScript: the level holds flat through noise, a channel rides it, and each flip is labelled.

bollinger.alt: Bollinger Bands on a BHEL 15 minute chart with a shaded band, an orange basis and Breakout and Breakdown labels
bollinger.caption: Bollinger Bands from bollinger(): three plots, a fill between the outer two, and a signal where price closes outside a band.
